title: A unified approach for estimation of unnormalized models via Stein operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.29510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we develop a unified framework connecting proper scoring rules and Stein's method for the estimation of unnormalized models. We construct a class of proper scoring rules that encompasses score matching, ratio matching, pseudolikelihood, and noise contrastive estimation. We show that these proper scoring rules naturally induce Stein operators. This connection yields a new construction principle for Stein operators, and enables us to study estimators based on these scoring rules through the geometry associated with the induced Stein operators. Using this geometric perspective, we provide a unified characterization of the asymptotic efficiency of the resulting estimators.

translated_title: 基于Stein算子的非归一化模型估计的统一方法
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个统一的框架，将适当评分规则与Stein方法相联系，用于非归一化模型的估计。我们构建了一类适当评分规则，它涵盖了分数匹配、比率匹配、伪似然和噪声对比估计。我们证明了这些适当评分规则会自然地诱导出Stein算子。这一联系为Stein算子的构造提供了新的原理，并使我们能够通过所诱导的Stein算子相关的几何结构来研究基于这些评分规则的估计量。利用这一几何视角，我们对所得估计量的渐近效率给出了统一的刻画。
tldr: 本文建立了一个连接适当评分规则与Stein方法的统一框架，证明分数匹配、比率匹配、伪似然和噪声对比估计等评分规则可自然诱导Stein算子，并借助由此产生的几何视角统一刻画了相应估计量的渐近效率。
